verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents app-event triggers across thousands of integrated apps (e.g. Twitter, GitHub), plus Email and HTTP/Webhook triggers and deployable event sources. A community user also describes an Airtable base that auto-feeds into Algolia, which corroborates record-driven automation. missing for 10: explicit documentation of specific event types such as new-record, new-message, and form-submission triggers, and in-depth trigger configuration detail beyond the summary list.
